upright.core: Means the wellspring of feeling opening anew. The pure beginning energy of love, empathy, intuition and spiritual fullness overflowing — a sign that the heart is ready to open and receive.
upright.general: Your heart is filling up again. New feelings, a new connection, or a heart long closed finally opening — that current is flowing. It's fine to accept the flutter exactly as it is.
upright.love: New love may begin, or affection well up again in an existing bond. Express your feelings first and you can catch a good current.
upright.money: Pleasant money news, or income that feels like a gift, may arrive. Receive it gratefully — and manage it with a plan.
upright.career: An emotionally satisfying start is possible in a new project or team. Creative ideas are welling up too.
upright.advice: Trust the direction your heart is pulling and take the first step.

reversed.core: Means the flow of feeling blocked or leaking away. Suppressed emotion, love unexpressed, emotional emptiness — pointing to the need to tend the inner life and restore the source.
reversed.general: Feelings may be pooling inside, or the heart hard to open. Like a tipped cup losing its water, check whether your emotional energy is leaking. Admitting the pressed-down feelings is where recovery starts.
reversed.love: You may be unable to express your heart, or the feeling may be flowing one way, like an unanswered crush. If it isn't coming back as it should, step back a while and tend to yourself.
reversed.money: Emotional spending drains the wallet easily now. Ask yourself if the purchase is really stress relief in disguise.
reversed.career: Meaning and affection for the work may be hard to find. It's time to search again for what this work means to you.
reversed.advice: Don't rush to fill the empty heart — be gentle with yourself first.

upright.core: Means the mutual exchange of two beings meeting as equals. Harmony and trust in love, friendship and partnership — a balanced union built on respect.
upright.general: Two hearts are meeting at the same height. Whether romance, friendship or collaboration, a balanced, mutually respectful relationship is likely to form. Honest conversation is the key this season.
upright.love: Affection is moving both ways. The spark grows into a relationship; the relationship grows into deeper trust.
upright.money: A partnership or a shared financial plan may click. Working with someone trustworthy can turn into profit.
upright.career: Collaboration with a like-minded colleague or partner bears fruit. One-to-one meetings and interviews leave a good impression too.
upright.advice: For balance, check that you give as much as you get — and get as much as you give.

reversed.core: Means the relationship's balance broken and the connection out of joint. Misunderstanding, discord, feeling flowing one way — with the need to restore harmony through communication.
reversed.general: The balance may have tipped to one side. Misunderstanding or thin communication is widening the distance. But this misalignment has plenty of room to mend through conversation.
reversed.love: Expectations diverge and small quarrels multiply. Honest talk, not silence, is what protects the relationship.
reversed.money: Money issues may strain a close relationship. Don't leave financial promises vague — pin them down.
reversed.career: Collaboration is out of step, or cracks are showing in a partnership. Realign roles and expectations.
reversed.advice: Don't stockpile the hurt — take it out and resolve it while it's small.

upright.core: Means celebration and communal bonds — joy shared together. The abundance that friendship, gathering and cooperation bring, and the happiness that grows larger for not being alone.
upright.general: Something worth celebrating together is in the air. You'll draw energy from friends, colleagues, community. Step in among people rather than toiling alone and the good things multiply.
upright.love: A connection may come through a gathering or an introduction. Couples can expect happy news that draws congratulations.
upright.money: Financial wins worth toasting, or income to share, may arrive. Social spending can climb though — enjoy it, but set a line.
upright.career: A team success, a good link made over dinner or networking. The bonds with colleagues strengthen your career.
upright.advice: Don't ration the good news — share it. This is a season where joy grows by dividing.

reversed.core: Means excess and discord within the group. Fatigue from too much socialising, relationships that stay on the surface, third-party interference — time to re-examine the quality of your connections.
reversed.general: The gatherings may be wearing you out. You mingle on the outside while the heart drifts, or too many commitments have drained you. It's a signal you need some time alone.
reversed.love: A third party, or the chatter of people around you, may shake the relationship. Protect the time that belongs to just the two of you.
reversed.money: Social costs — rounds, gifts, occasions — may be weighing on you. Prioritise instead of attending everything.
reversed.career: Take care not to be drawn into office gossip or factions. Keep some distance and mind your own work.
reversed.advice: You don't have to show up to everything. Choose the relationships that fill you back up.

upright.core: Means emotional weariness and dissatisfaction with the present. A listless state that has lost interest in what's given — a period of inward sinking that fails to notice the new opportunity being held out.
upright.general: What you have may have gone stale, the days dull. Yet a new cup may be extended right in front of you, unnoticed. Boredom is also an invitation to look again at your direction.
upright.love: Familiarity may have dimmed the flutter. Ask whether their kindness has started to feel like furniture.
upright.money: Unsatisfied with the finances but not moving either — a stall. Start with one small money check-up.
upright.career: Motivation dips and routine takes over. Look once more for the offer or opening you may be walking past.
upright.advice: Before missing what you lack, look around at the chance already beside you.

reversed.core: Means emerging from apathy, attention turning back to the world. The end of listlessness, motivation recovering, the move to catch what was missed.
reversed.general: You're getting ready to climb out of the long stall. The fog of listlessness lifts, interest in the world returns, and your hands reach for the postponed things. Don't waste this small spark of will.
reversed.love: The closed-hearted season passes and you're opening to connection again. You may find yourself responding warmly to a new meeting — or a reunion.
reversed.money: The engine restarts on postponed money management and new income leads. The more you move, the more the current revives.
reversed.career: Past the slump, new goals come into view. It's fine to look seriously at changes — a move, a new project.
reversed.advice: That itch to move again is the signal. Start today, even small.

upright.core: Means loss and the sorrow and regret that follow. Eyes fixed on what was spilled, blind to what still stands — while reminding you that not everything is lost.
upright.general: Your heart is lingering on what was lost. Staring at the three spilled cups, you may be missing the two still standing behind you. Grieve fully — and remember, too, that you have not lost everything.
upright.love: A parting or a disappointment may have left you aching. The regret is real, but this feeling will make the next bond sturdier.
upright.money: There may have been a loss or a purchase you regret. Focus less on the amount than on the lesson that stops the repeat.
upright.career: A failed project, a missed opening — the ache remains. But this experience becomes the record that feeds the next chance.
upright.advice: When you've grieved enough, turn your head — and count what's still standing.

reversed.core: Means accepting the sorrow and moving toward recovery. Acceptance of loss, forgiveness, the sorting of the past — the healing turn back toward what remains.
reversed.general: The end of the tunnel of grief is coming into view. The recovering current — accepting the loss, facing forward again — is flowing. Clear the past and a new space opens in the heart.
reversed.love: You're releasing the old wound and readying your heart. Forgiveness, reconciliation, or the room to accept someone new is growing.
reversed.money: Chances to recover the loss are appearing bit by bit. Calm rebuilding beats forced win-backs.
reversed.career: You've digested the failure and the strength to try again is returning. Fold the last project's lessons into the next plan.
reversed.advice: Forgiving the past isn't for the past's sake — it's for your today.

upright.core: Means the comfort that warm memory and an innocent heart bring to the present. Reminiscence, nostalgia, reunion with old ties — recovering the unconditional tenderness of childhood giving and receiving.
upright.general: Warm memories are lending strength to the present. An old friend may reach out, or comfort may come from familiar things. Recovering that innocent heart may be exactly today's assignment.
upright.love: A reunion with an old flame, or a long friendship turning into love. Affection blooming out of ease is the mark of this season.
upright.money: Old effort may pay off late, or help may come from family and those close. Be sure to say thank you.
upright.career: Ties to former colleagues or an old workplace may open new doors. Past experience and skills shine right now.
upright.advice: Draw strength from the good memories — but keep your feet in today.

reversed.core: Means the present blurred by clinging to the past. The gilding of days gone by, a nostalgia that blocks the way forward — keep the memories, but turn the eyes to now.
reversed.general: Too much time in the past may be blurring the present. 'It was better then' is holding your ankle. Keep the memories — and move your gaze to today.
reversed.love: You may not have stepped out of an old relationship's shadow. Stop comparing, and the person in front of you comes into focus.
reversed.money: Old spending habits — 'it used to work' — may not fit today's books. Update the standard to the current situation.
reversed.career: Clinging to old methods and past formulas can leave you behind. What's needed is the posture of learning the new current.
reversed.advice: Instead of gilding the past, focus on the good memory you could make today.

upright.core: Means the confusion and illusion of standing before too many options. Among the attractive possibilities float mirages with no substance — imagination and reality need telling apart.
upright.general: So many tempting options that you can't decide. Some are real openings; some are mirage. Imagine freely — but decide on evidence that stands in reality.
upright.love: You can't settle your heart among several people, or you may be idealising someone beyond life size. See the actual person, not the fantasy.
upright.money: Tempting investment stories are circulating. The better it looks, the harder it deserves checking.
upright.career: The deliberation between paths and offers runs deep. Don't hold every door open — set a standard and narrow to two or three.
upright.advice: Not choosing is also a choice. Fix one criterion and the fog lifts.

reversed.core: Means waking from illusion to face reality. Scattered options sorted, judgement clarified, the moment of decision — the process by which what you truly want becomes plain.
reversed.general: You're waking from the fantasy and reality is sharpening. The scattered options sort themselves, and what you really want is likely to become clear. A good current for making the call.
reversed.love: The rose tint is fading and you're seeing the relationship as it is. It may sting — but the real relationship starts here.
reversed.money: The vague financial plan is turning concrete. Strip out the inflated hopes, set reachable goals, and the current improves.
reversed.career: Career priorities clarify and the strength to focus on one arrives. You've decided — now execute.
reversed.advice: Trust this clarified judgement, and tie off the decision you'd postponed.

upright.core: Means the resolve to leave behind what does not fill you. An inner journey in search of deeper meaning and emotional satisfaction over material security — the mature relinquishment, the turn.
upright.general: The sense is arriving that it's time to walk away from what you worked to build. It may look fine on the outside while your heart says 'this isn't it.' Leaving isn't fleeing — it's the journey toward a deeper satisfaction.
upright.love: Your heart may be leaving an unfilling relationship. If you're weighing the ending, don't shut out that inner voice.
upright.money: If the money comes at the heart's expense, it's time to re-examine. Look for a way that can be sustained.
upright.career: You're seriously weighing resignation, a move, a change of direction. The measure will be 'does this work fill me' — not the salary line.
upright.advice: The courage to leave the familiar opens the door to the next chapter.

reversed.core: Means hovering between leaving and staying. Unable to close for lingering attachment — or fleeing in the name of leaving; the half-hearted stance must end and the direction be made plain.
reversed.general: Your heart is swinging between go and stay. Check whether attachment stops you closing it — or whether the leaving is really an escape. While the decision waits, the energy keeps leaking.
reversed.love: A relationship ended but not ended, or the lingering after the ending, may be holding you. Return or leave — ending the in-between comes first.
reversed.money: Are you clutching an expense or investment you should cut, out of reluctance? Judgement free of sunk cost is what's needed.
reversed.career: The wanting-to-quit and wanting-to-stay keep alternating. Judge by a concrete scorecard, not by the mood of the day.
reversed.advice: If you stay, stay properly. If you leave, don't look back.

upright.core: Means the wish achieved and deep satisfaction. Enjoying the emotional and material abundance earned by effort — traditionally called the 'wish card', the realisation of what was hoped for.
upright.general: They call this the wish card, and its current is running strong — what you hoped for is coming true. You're likely to enjoy the fruit of your effort, satisfied in heart and in hand. Go ahead and savour the abundance.
upright.love: What you wished for in the relationship is arriving — a confession, a step forward, a settling. Your heart is likely to feel full.
upright.money: There's breathing room, and the purchase or goal you wanted is within reach. Toast the achievement — and quietly set the next target.
upright.career: Recognition and the result you wanted are possible now. Promotion, a pass, a signed deal — good news is likely.
upright.advice: Savour what has come true. Gratitude is what invites the next abundance.

reversed.core: Means the hollowness after achievement, or satisfaction that will not fill. Overreaching, complacency, the emptiness behind visible plenty — the reasons for the wanting need revisiting.
reversed.general: You seem to have everything, yet one corner stays hollow. The achievement pays less joy than promised, or over-wanting is gnawing at it. Time to ask not 'how much' but 'why did I want it'.
reversed.love: Filling only your own wants can tip the balance. Look to their satisfaction too, and the warmth returns.
reversed.money: Show spending and reward-myself spending leak the finances now. Check whether you're trying to buy the feeling of enough.
reversed.career: Results fall short of hopes, or the summit feels empty. Rebuild the inner motive alongside the outer win.
reversed.advice: Practise enjoying deeply what you already have, rather than having more.

upright.core: Means the happy completion of the emotional journey. Harmony within family and community, lasting love, emotional fullness — the most settled fruit a relationship can bear.
upright.general: The journey of the heart is completing beautifully. Deep steadiness and happiness are likely with family, partner, the people close in. Like the rainbow — the relationships you tended are bearing fruit.
upright.love: The relationship is moving to settled ground — marriage, living together, long promises. A fine time to sketch the shared future.
upright.money: A stable financial current shared with family is in view. Plans and spending around home carry a good energy.
upright.career: Work-life balance settles and the team is in harmony. A steady environment supports steady results.
upright.advice: Don't let this happiness become furniture — say it out loud to the people who built it with you.

reversed.core: Means the gap between the ideal of harmony and the reality. Discord at home or among the closest, happiness staged for show — what's needed is honest repair, not the perfect picture.
reversed.general: The gap between the picture and the reality may be aching. Discord and hurt are surfacing at home or nearby. Stop chasing the perfect image — listen to the relationship's real voice.
reversed.love: Fine on the surface, out of joint underneath. Stop measuring against other people's posted happiness and find your own pace.
reversed.money: Money issues in the family, friction over the home, may arise. Separate the feelings from the figures and talk it through calmly.
reversed.career: The work-life balance has tipped and one side is being sacrificed. The priorities need renegotiating.
reversed.advice: Trade the fantasy of the perfect family for honest conversation — that's what makes real harmony.

upright.core: Means an unexpected heartfelt message and creative inspiration. Innocent curiosity, imagination, the sprout of a new feeling — the open posture that receives intuition's signals.
upright.general: An unexpected message that knocks at the heart is arriving. New feelings, creative inspiration, innocent curiosity are budding. Like the fish popping out of the cup — open up to the surprising, welcome signal.
upright.love: A sweet confession or a signal of interest is likely. It may seem naive — and still be completely sincere.
upright.money: Small but pleasant money news may arrive. A creative idea could seed a side income.
upright.career: Curiosity about a new field may become a career turning point. Approach as a learner and good chances follow.
upright.advice: Don't dismiss the small flutter — follow the signal.

reversed.core: Means clumsiness in expressing feeling and daydreams that never reach reality. Mood swings, fickleness, delayed news — imagination needs the training that carries it into the real.
reversed.general: Feelings come out clumsy, or stay as daydreams that never land. The awaited news is late and the moods swing wide. This is the season to practise shaping the heart before showing it.
reversed.love: Awkward expression or fickle behaviour breeds misunderstanding. Sort the feelings once before pouring them out.
reversed.money: Impulsive, emotional spending rises easily. Practise separating 'want' from 'need'.
reversed.career: Ideas outrun execution. Finish the very smallest one first.
reversed.advice: Don't stay in the daydream — take one idea out into reality today.

upright.core: Means an offer carried with the heart, a romantic approach. The graceful pursuit of feeling and ideals — the invitation of love or opportunity drawing near.
upright.general: An offer or invitation with real heart in it is approaching. It's a romantic, appealing current, and you'll want to move as the feeling leads. Advance gracefully toward the ideal — and mind the ground under your feet as you go.
upright.love: A romantic confession or an invitation to a date is likely. Prepare the romance yourself and the response will be warm.
upright.money: An attractive offer may come — but don't decide on atmosphere; check the terms. Spending or investing in aesthetic things may tempt you.
upright.career: Tempting doors may open — a scout, an invitation to collaborate. A good season for artistic and emotional strengths.
upright.advice: If your heart has moved, say so — romantically, and with respect.

reversed.core: Means the shadow of romance where words and deeds diverge. Promises unkept, ideals without footing, charm that is all surface — judge by consistent action, not by feeling.
reversed.general: Beware the current where the words are sweet and the actions don't follow. In their offer or your own plan, romance may be hiding the practicalities. Judge by consistency, not by mood.
reversed.love: A glossy approach, a promise that can't be kept, may sway you. It isn't too late to open your heart after watching the actions.
reversed.money: Guard against offers wrapped in fine stories, and against impulse buys. The habit of reading the contract and the numbers yourself will protect you.
reversed.career: The offer differs from the pitch, or your own drive outpaces your follow-through. Focus on finishing what's started.
reversed.advice: Enjoy the romance — but believe only the promises already kept.

upright.core: Means deep empathy, intuition and emotional maturity. The power to read feelings — your own and others' — finely and hold them warmly; the wisdom that sees a problem's essence with the heart's eye.
upright.general: Deep empathy and intuition are shining. You're reading feelings finely and holding the people around you warmly. A problem logic couldn't crack may show its answer to the heart's eye.
upright.love: A mature love that understands both hearts deeply is possible now. The tenderness that reads their feelings takes the bond a level deeper.
upright.money: Intuitive judgement is helping the money decisions. But think twice about spending driven purely by affection.
upright.career: Strength shows in work that handles hearts — counselling, care, the arts. Being the team's emotional anchor comes back as trust.
upright.advice: Trust the signal your gut is sending. Right now it's remarkably accurate.

reversed.core: Means the centre lost to overwhelming feeling. Over-identification, dependence, self-care neglected — boundaries needed so that empathy doesn't become depletion.
reversed.general: You may be sinking into the feelings and losing yourself. Caring for everyone has left your own heart unattended, or the swings are clouding the calls. Time to shore up the banks so the water of empathy doesn't flood.
reversed.love: The relationship may lean too hard on them, or drain you emotionally. Care for yourself in the same measure you care for them.
reversed.money: Watch spending and lending born of pity or anxiety. Refusing is also financial self-defence.
reversed.career: Over-identification is rocking your judgement, or burnout nears. Draw a line between the work and the feelings.
reversed.advice: Before you hold anyone else today — hold your own heart first.

upright.core: Means the mature command and balance of feeling. Wisdom that keeps composure and tolerance in heated moments — leadership in which heart and head have found their harmony.
upright.general: Like the king steady on a heaving sea, the mature power to govern feeling is with you. Even in heated moments you can hold the centre with calm and generosity. People are likely to lean on your counsel and your steadiness.
upright.love: A deep, stable love that doesn't get tossed by the waves is possible. A generous, embracing manner hardens the trust.
upright.money: Balanced decisions with the feelings set aside lead to good results. The long view is especially favoured.
upright.career: Leadership that mediates conflict and steadies the team is being recognised. The mentor's role strengthens your career.
upright.advice: Take one breath before responding. That composure is your power.

reversed.core: Means feeling suppressed and warped by the suppression. Calm on the surface, boiling underneath — cynicism, emotional manipulation, the unexpected eruption; command and repression must be told apart.
reversed.general: You look calm, but the pressed-down feelings may be simmering. What was swallowed leaks out as coldness, sarcasm, or a sudden burst. Remember: commanding your feelings and gagging them are different things.
reversed.love: The unexpressed heart reads as a wall to them. Ask whether you're hiding feelings under the name of maturity.
reversed.money: Decisions made under piled-up stress swerve from your usual sense. Push the big ones to after the water settles.
reversed.career: Enduring in silence can curdle into cynicism, or a commanding air opens distance with the team. Honest communication restores the leadership.
reversed.advice: Don't swallow the feeling — take it out and say it, in a safe way.
